_doc: varclaims colour stage (2026-11-17, flankko process): one meaning, one colour across Figs 1-4. Roles: cSup = supported genome-wide / variants mostly supported; cNot = not supported / rarely supported; cPart = partly supported (5-50%); cRest = the genome-wide record and claims restating it; cFirst = claims that came before the first genome-wide report; cClin = ClinVar risk variants. Context variables (study populations, designs, chromosomes, size classes) are warm greys or ramps of a role; trait areas keep the paper's area colours. S0 = the v3 colours made consistent; S1-S4 take their hues from the user's rating-3 reference figures (same references as the flankko colour page).

SF.name: User pick 2026-11-17: S2 base; supported/not/partly from S1; restated/first from S4; ClinVar from S3
